concept.title: Manage your authentication and access your Red Hat account
concept.shortdesc: Once integrated, you can use your company single sign-on to login to your Red Hat account.

conbody.p:
The following procedures describe how to log in to your Red Hat account and configure your company single sign-on integration:
Log in without company single sign-on (SSO) integration.
Link your Red Hat account to your company SSO for the first time and log in.
Log in to your Red Hat account when company single sign-on is enabled.
Update your linked company SSO.
If you previously used a social login to log in to your Red Hat account, you will see an error message when company single sign-on (SSO) is enabled for your organization. A message appears on your Red Hat account screen: Log in with company single sign-on. Company single sign-on is required to access your account.
Click the link Log in with company single sign-on. to continue.
